rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the context already makes clear that the salesperson is a woman.

example.english: I want to ask the saleswoman whether this shirt comes in other colours.
example.traditional: 我想問下個售貨員，呢件衫有冇其他顏色？
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa6 go3 sau6 fo3 jyun4 ne1 gin6 saam1 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 ngaan4 sik1

rows.note: Choose this when you need to state explicitly that the shop salesperson is female.

example.english: That female saleswoman helped me choose a skirt that fits me well.
example.traditional: 嗰位女售貨員幫我揀咗一條好啱身嘅裙。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 neoi5 sau6 fo3 jyun4 bong1 ngo5 gaan2 zo2 jat1 tiu4 hou2 ngaam1 san1 ge3 kwan4
